reviews_captured_by_me.text:
I've had the pleasure of working with Continental Wood and Stone on multiple occasions, and their consistent excellence has made them my go-to for all custom kitchen, and woodworking needs. Their exceptional craftsmanship is evident in the four kitchen renovations they've completed for me, along with various custom wood projects.

What truly sets this team apart is their rare combination of quality, efficiency, and attention to detail. Each project is executed with meticulous precision, and they maintain immaculate work areas throughout the process. Beyond their technical expertise, they bring a refreshing personality to the job site that makes the renovation experience genuinely enjoyable.

For anyone considering kitchen renovations or custom woodworking, I cannot recommend Continental Wood and Stone highly enough. Their unparalleled skill and professional approach have exceeded my expectations with every project.

Nathan and his team at Continental Wood and Stone do phenomenal work. Not only are their installations flawless but Nathan has great ideas and suggestions that the average homeowner might not think about. I have had them install countertops in my own house and now that I’m a contractor they are my exclusive installer.

Nathan, Lindsey, and the team made my dream kitchen come true! From planning to install they were very responsive, professional, and kind.
The cabinets arrived quickly and are absolutely beautiful.
They did the installation in one day and every single cabinet is perfect.
Honestly, I would choose this company over and over again.

Thanks again guys!!
